Searching `FLEXBOX` in both correctly left just the CSS grid bookmark, since "flexbox" is sitting in my note even though it's nowhere in the title — and it didn't care that I typed it in capitals. That's exactly the behavior I want: it looks across the title, the description, and my own notes, and ignores capitalization.

Between the two, version A — where the list narrows as I type — feels more natural. I often don't know the exact word, so watching results shrink while I type lets me stop as soon as I see what I want. Version B making me finish and press Search is fine, but it's an extra step for something I do constantly. So let's go with A.

One addition to your assumption: I'd also want the web address itself to be searchable, not just title, description, and notes. Sometimes all I remember is that it was on "web.dev" or "mozilla," and I'd want to type that and find it. So please fold the address into what search looks through as well.
